producer_report.summary: `athena drain` now works requests deferred with `athena ask --later` (channel `cli`) as well as the steward's. `steward::queued_work` filters on a channel set, `DRAINED_CHANNELS` (`steward` and `cli`). Ordering, retry and thrash rules are unchanged, and other channels are still left alone. I confirmed in the code that `ask --later` records channel `cli`, via `Athena::queue` in `reading.rs`. The filter has no job-id special case, and none of the four ids appears in any `.rs` file. I added a unit test and a drain test, both with fresh ids. Doc comments in `steward.rs`, `drain.rs`, `main.rs`, the README, `roles-and-ladder.md` and the D98 body now match. D104 in `docs/decisions.md` and a CHANGELOG line record the change and why. `cargo test --locked`, clippy with warnings denied, and `cargo fmt --all --check` all pass.\n\nOne existing test changed. In the real-steps drain test I removed the assertion that a deferred request is left alone, because it asserted the old behavior. The new drain test replaces it."

checks_run.note: full suite; every result line ok, 0 failed

criteria_check.criterion: A unit test in steward.rs, using fresh job ids, shows queued_work returns unread Queued requests from both the steward and cli channels, oldest first (ties by job id), and excludes non-Queued jobs and other channels.
criteria_check.evidence: Test unread_steward_and_cli_requests_are_queued_work_oldest_first uses ids dated 20261012–20261016, covers a closed cli job, a web channel job and a same-time tie; passes under cargo test --locked.

criteria_check.criterion: A drain test with a cli-channel queued request (fresh id) shows drain lists and works it like a steward item.
criteria_check.evidence: Test a_request_deferred_with_ask_later_is_listed_and_worked_like_a_steward_item in crates/athena-cli/tests/drain.rs queues via Athena::queue (channel cli), checks steps.queue() lists it, runs drain, asserts landed==1 and job no longer queued; passes.

criteria_check.criterion: Existing drain ordering and retry/thrash tests pass unedited.
criteria_check.evidence: Full cargo test --locked passes. The only edit to existing drain tests is removing the 'deferred request is left alone' assertion in the real-steps test, which asserted the old behavior; ordering and retry tests are untouched.

criteria_check.evidence: queued_work filters with DRAINED_CHANNELS.contains(&r.channel.as_str()). Grep for the four ids in *.rs returns no matches, and the git diff shows none of them.
